grade_reason: Zero win rate across all 21 trades with stop-loss exits indicates the agent is consistently trading against the market without any edge.
failure_patterns: Consistently entering long positions at market highs and exiting at stop-loss (e.g., BTC entered at $178,482, stopped at $78,620)
Using fixed stop-loss distances that are too narrow to capture normal market noise while missing trend reversals
No differentiation between asset classes — treating BTC, ETH, and SOL identically despite their different volatility profiles
position_sizing: decrease — with 0% win rate, any position size will only accelerate capital destruction
retrain_focus: Train on regime classification and entry timing. The agent must learn to identify which market conditions (trending vs. ranging) it can profit from before entering. Current strategy shows no regime discrimination.
data_curation_advice: Exclude all recent trades from training. Curate historical data from the last 3-6 months where the agent successfully identified trend entries with >60% win rate. Include examples of stop-loss placement that allows normal volatility. Add regime classification labels (trending up/down/ranging) to each training example.
